basic_info.description: Perched atop the prestigious 255 Berry Street, this exceptional 2BR/2BA residence is a premier penthouse within the building, offering a rare blend of luxury, privacy, and breathtaking views with three private terraces overlooking the city skyline, Mission Creek, and surrounding parklands. Soaring 12-foot ceilings and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows fill the open living space with natural light, while motorized shades including blackout options in both bedrooms ensure effortless comfort. The sleek modern kitchen features high-end finishes and breakfast seating, perfect for both daily living and entertaining. A spacious primary suite boasts generous closets and a spa-inspired en suite bath, complemented by a well-appointed second bedroom and full guest bath. Multiple terraces create seamless indoor-outdoor flow, ideal for lounging or al fresco dining. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Mission Bay near the booming biotech, AI and tech, and finance centers, Oracle Park, Chase Center, Caltrain, and highways to Silicon Valley and SFO, this home includes EV parking, private storage, concierge service, and a beautifully landscaped courtyard. This is an extraordinary opportunity in one of San Francisco's most dynamic neighborhoods.
